name: DyNeRF
definition: A baseline method that represents the volumetric video with a NeRF-like MLP, which takes spatial coordinate and temporal embedding as input and predicts the radiance field at a particular video frame.
summary: DyNeRF is a baseline method for dynamic scene synthesis that uses a single shared MLP conditioned on spatial and temporal embeddings, distinguishing itself by lacking explicit deformation fields or canonical space mappings.
